about: NOAA Atlas 14 core shared byte-identical with DamIT PMP; checked by DamSafety_PMP/tests/test_atlas14_shared.py and DamIT's scripts/check_atlas14_shared.py.
rule: The five files in DamSafety_PMP/noaa14/ (atlas14, temporal, storm, gisgrid, gridstats) are the NOAA Atlas 14 core shared byte-identical with DamIT PMP (damit_pmp/<name>.py in nickdbendickson/damit). A change to one must be made the same way in both repositories, on paired branches of the same name (code flows DamIT -> DWR only; nothing from the AWA-derived ND PMP tool goes to DamIT). Then update SHARED.json with: python3 DamSafety_PMP/tests/test_atlas14_shared.py --write --damit <DamIT checkout>. DamIT's scripts/check_atlas14_shared.py checks the pair daily.
